[b]Knesset Approves Funding to Construct NDL[/b]

[i]-Issue 115 HaKeshet-

On Wednesday the Knesset with the support of the Prime Minister approved a new bill that allocates $11 billion over the next year to complete the National Defensive Line. The NDL, first announced in 2025, was proposed by the Mizrahel Security Forces and major defense industry players including Peretz-Harris, MAI and Naveh. The line is set to include both traditional barriers and a newly developed robotic network stretching across the eastern land border. Incorporating drone interceptors, networked systems, tank barriers and other autonomous systems the system is meant to work towards slowing down a hostile armor advance into Mizrahel and allow time for the MSF to respond. In a speech to the Knesset the Prime Minister repeatedly emphasised the purely defensive and deterrence based nature of the line and its importance in future security.[/i]
